false_claims.claim: 随后 `DELETE ct_items.` 不带 `WHERE`，删的是 `sy-tabix` 当前指的那一行
false_claims.why_wrong: D38: `DELETE ct_items.` with no WHERE clause and no FROM/TO deletes every remaining row of ct_items, not the single row at sy-tabix; the report therefore describes a one-row deletion and misses the mass deletion (repeated at report lines 234 and 2065).

D23: iv_zhrtip is substringed at a fixed offset with no length check, so an initial/short value raises a substring runtime error before any comparison; the report says the empty case cleanly raises zcx_fi_zhrtip.

false_claims.claim: 所以这段 `TRY` 是纯装饰
false_claims.why_wrong: D28: the whole BDC body sits in TRY...ENDTRY with no CATCH, so every failure including the submit error is swallowed and the caller is told the open items were cleared; the report instead treats the TRY as inert and, at line 1597, advises deleting it.

false_claims.claim: 会按 FM 设定的消息类型终止程序
false_claims.why_wrong: D33: after the failed POSTING_INTERFACE_START there is no RETURN, so execution falls through and POSTING_INTERFACE_CLEARING and POSTING_INTERFACE_END are still called without a session.

false_claims.claim: 在 Open SQL 里条件不成立 → 返回 0 行，行为安全
false_claims.why_wrong: D37: the RFITEMGL range is only guarded by `IF sy-subrc = 0.`, so an assigned but empty SD_SAKNR range silently omits all general-ledger opening balances; the report calls this behaviour safe.

false_claims.claim: 行为上恰好无害，但应显式注释
false_claims.why_wrong: D35: in the RFITEMGL branch both umskz and filkd are commented out of the bsis/bsas field lists, so they reach the COLLECT aggregation initial for every general-ledger account (the report only says the DELETE is a harmless no-op and never mentions filkd).

false_claims.claim: `WHERE ... AND ( lifnr = it_hesap-sube OR lifnr = it_hesap-merkez )` 这个写法有隐患
false_claims.why_wrong: D36: the report calls this construct 逻辑正确 and only notes an extra empty comparison per FOR ALL ENTRIES row; it never states that combining FOR ALL ENTRIES with a parenthesised OR on the driver row destroys the per-row correlation and degrades the join to a filtered cross product.

D39: the source assigns zzbstkd from zuonr inside the LOOP AT ct_items ASSIGNING loop, mutating a sort-key component mid-iteration; the report's excerpt quotes a different assignment, so it never reaches that defect (excerpt repeated at report line 801).
